question: Which of the following can be considered a DEMERIT of the parliamentary form of government ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unstable government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In a parliamentary system, the government is directly dependent on the support of the parliament, especially the lower house, which often leads to instability.
 
• Frequent elections and changes in government can occur if the ruling party loses the confidence of the parliament.
 
• Coalition governments are common in parliamentary systems, which can result in compromises and unstable governance.
 
• Political instability can lead to challenges in long-term policy planning and implementation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wide representation:**

 
 
• This is an advantage of the parliamentary system where different sections of society are represented through elected members.
 
• It ensures a diverse and inclusive government.
 
 
 
• **Prevents despotism:**
 
 
• In a parliamentary system, the executive is accountable to the legislature, which helps in preventing authoritarian rule.
 
• Regular elections and parliamentary oversight ensure checks and balances.
 
 
 
• **Responsible government:**
 
 
• The executive is accountable to the parliament and, through it, to the electorate.
 
• This accountability ensures that the government remains responsible and responsive to the needs of the people.
 
 
 
• **Unstable government:**
 
 
• This is a demerit as frequent changes in government can lead to inconsistency in policies and governance.
 
• It can hinder long-term planning and development due to a lack of continuity.
